---
title: "📦 Installation"
---

You need [conda](https://conda-forge.org/download/) (Miniforge, Miniconda or Anaconda). Download the environment file and create the environment:

```bash
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrc-ide/KR_simulator/main/environment-user.yml
conda env create -f environment-user.yml
conda activate krsim
```

The environment is called `krsim`. It contains krsim, its dependencies, and Jupyter with matplotlib for the [tutorial](tutorial-small.qmd).

## Check the install

With the environment active, run:

```bash
krsim --help
```

It lists every command. `krsim <command> --help` lists every option for one command.

## Update

pip does not reinstall krsim while the version number is unchanged, so force it to fetch the latest code:

```bash
pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps git+https://github.com/mrc-ide/KR_simulator.git
```
